entry.name: pipe
entry.description: Delays numbers, lists of numbers or symbols. pipe uses the Max time format syntax, so the delay interval can be either fixed or tempo-relative.

arguments.name: initialization
arguments.digest: Initialize values, inlet/outlet count, and delay time
arguments.description: The number of arguments to theobject depends on the number of items in a list you wish to delay, but the final argument is always used to set the initial value for the delay time.If no argument is specified, the initial value is 0 and the delay time is 0 ms.If there is one argument, this sets the delay time.If there are two arguments, the first argument sets an initial value to be stored in, and the second argument sets the delay time.If more than two arguments are present,creates additional inlets and outlets for delaying additional numbers.Theobject allows you to specify time intervals using either a number which specifies time in milliseconds (e.g. pipe 200) or a(e.g. pipe 2n).Note: While theobject lets you specify time in any of Max's standard, theattribute argument should be used when specifying time in any other time unit besides milliseconds or notevalues (e.g.@11025 samples).If notevalue, ticks, or bars.beats.units are specified for the delay interval, the object will not operate unless the transport is running.

attributes.digest: Quantize output
attributes.description: Quantizes the output ofto a specified time-boundary. This is achieved by making internal adjustments to the times used for sending output. messages.name: flush
messages.digest: Output and clear all held values
messages.description: Immediately sends out all values currently being delayed by, and clears theobject's memory. Values are sent out each outlet in reverse order from that in which they were received in the corresponding inlet.
